method: Read exact canonical UTF-8 blobs, recompute each size/SHA-256/Git blob identity, compare the four changed control texts to e03f, and cross-read the actual original compile producers. No Python parser, project import, subprocess, remote host request, workflow trigger, native compile or product test was run.

delta_findings.original_issue: Compile raw files had been read transiently, but their identities were not all returned by admission, included in the next owner input map or compared at finalization.
actual_changes: common.COMPILE_SUFFIXES fixes receipt, stdout, stderr, request, input and output in one ordered list.
preparation captures 41 ordered stages: B1, B2, and all 39 pool-first unit names. Each is recorded only after its actual compile_stage returned.
The producer retains both B0 image and raw receipt and compares parsed B0 receipt with the returned build_seed receipt.
preparation's finally block re-reads all completed compile originals with exact file identity and raw bytes; failed preservation forces HOLD.
verify.compile_record requires the exact stage and six fixed paths, re-reads raw bytes and full identity, and compares parsed original receipt to the report.
verify returns all 246 compile pins and both B0 pins in actual_preparation. It also requires the exact ordered 80-file prepared build inventory.
controller.actual_preparation_inputs includes those accepted pins in the test phase source_identities. The existing 262144-byte request ceiling rejects overflow.
finalize requires both exact naturally closed owners, re-reads preparation, and compares the entire resulting prepared value to admission before final product acceptance.
delta_findings.result_boundary: This closes the identified unbound raw-file mutation path in the static control graph. No such mutation or full run was executed in this review.

The 33 public-mode union, actual status totals, nonempty actual returns in each group and complete 116 method checks remain present.

actual_changes: The saved receipt now says DEVELOPMENT_PREPARATION_ACCEPTED and does not claim phase-two request readiness.
DEVELOPMENT_TEST_REQUEST_READY is printed only after create_phase('tests', ...) returns successfully.
setup_record and finalize consume the narrower acceptance status; final failure remains HOLD.
Preparation retains separate final copies of both fixed generated JSON files even when previous preparation work failed.
verify compares the final copies to the originally retained derived copies and actual current source; tests identities include both final pins.
snapshot checks the complete physical namespace before and after the full byte inventory, with only Git metadata excluded.
Exactly the two original coverage/support JSON paths remain mutable; complete source metadata, namespace, modes and all other leaf bytes stay required.

observations: The ten receipt-only fields removed before comparing child stdout are the seven fields appended by invoke plus the three appended by compile_stage.
The child actually emits the six limits keys that the new reader requires, with CPU 10 seconds, address 256 MiB, no core dump, stack 8 MiB, output 1 MiB and workspace 1 MiB.
The fixed compile_stage call uses the exact request fields required by compile_record; the controller requires absolute physical source/output paths.
The child writes the complete 1 MiB output buffer and its SHA; compile_stage writes the produced prefix and records the prefix size/SHA.
B1 uses seed-shared; B2 and the 39 units use flat-x86-64. The scoped native observer remains unselected during this independent preparation.

exclusions_and_open_inputs: This review does not parse the Python controls or run any source, native, ABI, installed-wheel, fault-injection or product test.
No final runnable policy, workflow or exact generated-assets candidate was available in this static revision. They still need exact source/pin binding and their own final review.
diagnostics.py was retrieved and byte-verified as part of the 13-file checkpoint; its entire framing algorithm is outside this requested delta clearance.
A complete fixed test-phase request may only run if it actually fits the unchanged 262144-byte guardian ceiling. This review does not claim that a future concrete request already fits.
The two separate development owners do not establish cold qualification, one combined 180-second result, production activation or whole-stack native completion.
The previous e03f findings and all earlier failures/unknown attempts remain immutable.
